title: AI Companies Can Also Raise Funds by Token: Guangdong Introduces Token Loans for the First Time

content_html:
On August 14, Guangdong Province's first specialized financial product for the token economy, "Token Loan," was launched in Haizhu District, Guangzhou, aiming to provide more suitable financing support for small and medium-sized enterprises related to computing power and AI.

Taking the Guangzhou Branch of Bank of China as an example, this branch has introduced the "Computing Power Token Loan" for small and medium-sized computing power enterprises in Haizhu District. The loan amount is determined based on the company's contract amount and Token consumption level. Mainly using credit, accounts receivable pledge, and order financing as guarantee methods, it can also combine additional credit enhancement measures such as guarantees and mortgages to further expand the loan limit. For newly established companies, if they can provide proof materials of continuous operations from the original business or guarantees, they can also apply for financing based on orders.

It is reported that Bank of China has already conducted trial credit approvals, with a cumulative fund scale reaching 28 million yuan. With the rapid expansion of large model applications, Token consumption has gradually become an important indicator of AI companies' operational activities. This type of financial product attempts to include computing power, Token usage, and order-related business data in the credit evaluation system, providing new credit assessment dimensions for AI company financing and marking the beginning of financial institutions exploring new financial service models adapted to the token economy.

content_html_zh:
8月14日，广东省首个通证经济专业化金融产品“通证贷”在广州海珠区上线，旨在为算力、人工智能相关的中小企业提供更合适的融资支持。

以中国银行广州分行为例，该分行针对海珠区中小算力企业推出了“算力通证贷”。 贷款金额根据公司合约金额和Token消耗水平确定。 主要采用授信、应收账款质押、订单融资等担保方式，还可结合担保、抵押等附加增信措施，进一步扩大贷款额度。 对于新成立的公司，如果能提供原有业务持续经营的证明材料或担保，也可以申请基于订单的融资。

据悉，中国银行已开展授信试点试点，累计资金规模达到2800万元。 随着大模型应用的快速拓展，Token消耗逐渐成为AI企业运营活动的重要指标。 此类金融产品尝试将算力、Token使用情况、订单相关业务数据纳入信用评估体系，为AI企业融资提供新的信用评估维度，标志着金融机构探索适应通证经济的新型金融服务模式的开始。
